title: d'Alembert's Functional Equation and a Globally Convex Free-Action Principle on Positive Paths
summary: We study the kinetic action that d'Alembert's functional equation induces on positive paths in $\Rplus$, and prove it strongly convex. Calibrated d'Alembert forces the cosh cost $\Jcost(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1$, i.e.\ $\Jlog(ξ)=\coshξ-1$ in the log coordinate $ξ=\log x$. Evaluating this log-cost at the log-\emph{velocity} $\dotξ$ rather than the log-position -- a single postulate (Postulate~\ref{post:step}) -- yields $\actionA[γ]=\int_a^b(\cosh\dotξ-1)\,dt$, strongly convex under geometric (log-space) interpolation.
